correctness.rationale: The profile-functional inequality and mixed identity give the normalized (n-1)-st moment of the transformed profile density. Exact Blaschke factorization then yields the two-channel deficit; Rényi monotonicity, D2=log(1+CV^2), and Pinsker give the stated corollaries. A direct projection-body computation independently verifies equality of the strongest refinement on every right circular cylinder.

originality.rationale: The recent qualitative theorem, its profile transform, injectivity, and multilinear estimate are prior work and are not claimed as new. Targeted searches found no prior Rényi/entropy deficit, variance or total-variation stability hierarchy, two-channel Blaschke/profile decomposition, or cylinder sharpness statement for Petty's quotient on bodies of revolution.

value.rationale: The result extracts an explicit quantitative stability mechanism from the new qualitative proof, separates asymmetry from symmetric-profile shape, supplies several usable distance controls, and identifies a nonellipsoidal family on which the strongest divergence refinement is exactly sharp.
